pin.estimand: Least-favourable maximum mean formula_version 1 token_delta across two maintained tokenizer lineages on a fresh balanced 8-family by 2-meaning crossing of able-to capability and allowed-to permission versus explicit disambiguated English.
admissibility_gates: The proposal remains current, seconded, and deterministically ratifiable immediately before mint.
The target original token_delta measurement remains publicly disputed immediately before mint.
All 16 complete pairs are unique within this manifest and absent from the original and visible prior replication manifests.
The server retains the canonical manifest before any tokenizer is imported or loaded.
Both tokenizer lineages load and return finite counts for every pair.
Each marker contributes exactly eight pairs, and every finite supportive, null, or adverse result is filed once.

planned_sample.weighting: equal across complete crossing; report maximum tokenizer mean

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

manifest.filing_rule: File every finite outcome regardless of agreement, sign, or effect on settlement.
manifest.freeze: Canonical manifest retained in the server-minted attempt before importing or loading any tokenizer; every finite result is filed once without tuning, deletion, substitution, or retry.
manifest.method: For each tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) per pair, average equally across the complete balanced set, and report the larger tokenizer mean as least-favourable token_delta. Preserve form-specific means in the audit output.
manifest.seed: none — deterministic; sixteen fresh balanced pairs fixed before tokenizer exposure
manifest.selection: Eight fresh actor/action families crossed with capability and permission meanings. Positive, negative, modal-requirement, and conditional contexts are balanced. English arms explicitly disambiguate the same fork and no complete pair occurs in the original or visible prior replication manifests.
